items.question: How strong is his debilitated Jupiter really? (A)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: capricorn_h10_named=true; neecha_named=false; bhanga_explicitly_checked=false; classical_citation=true. bhanga presence-or-absence must be EXPLICIT per spec; proxy only detects the word, not explicit reasoning.

items.question: How is my career? (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: bhava=true; bhavesha=true; karaka=true; from_moon=true; varga_d10=true; yogas=true; timing=true; dissent_ge_1=true; verse_inline=true. Receipt-completeness fields checked textually; true "is it COMPLETE" semantics need LLM/human read.

items.question: His marriage prospects? (A)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: receipt_complete_with_d9=true; venus_exalted_named=true; twelfth_house_tension_addressed=true; time_sensitivity_flag=false. Whether BOTH strength and placement are "weighed" (not merely mentioned) requires LLM read.

items.question: My wealth outlook per my chart? (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: second_house=true; eleventh_house=false; jupiter=true; hora_varga=true; epistemic_grades=true. Hora varga (D2) mention is a weak proxy for "promise register consulted".

items.question: How is my 10th house FROM THE MOON? (N) [Q-frame]

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: from_moon_answer_verifiably_differs_from_lagna=true. NOTE: no single tool exposes an explicit lagna-vs-chandra house-10 judgment_query frame param; proxied via judgment_query(bhava=10) [lagna] + bodha_signals_get(frame=chandra) [moon-relative signals] — a structural approximation, not the exact product answer path.

items.question: What does Jaimini say about his career — chara karakas? (A) [Q-paradigm]

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: paradigm_jaimini_honored=true; amk_identified=true; no_parashari_mixing=true. "No mixing" is a crude keyword heuristic (astro-verifier semantics need LLM read).

items.question: Will I change jobs in the next year? (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: pact_chain_visible=true; posterior_with_baserate=false; falsifier=false; window_dates=true; ages=true. Whether posterior numerically lies in [0,1] not independently re-derived here — presence-only proxy.

items.question: Chances of a major health event in 5 years? (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: full_range_honesty_posterior_present=false; falsifier_present=false; no_alarmist_certainty_language=true. Sensitive-domain "care" tone is an LLM-rubric judgment, not mechanically checkable; keyword-absence is a weak proxy.

items.question: Will he settle abroad? (A)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: calibration_state_structural_disclosed=true; posterior_carries_structural_prior_grade=true. Used bhava=12 as the domain proxy for "settle abroad" since the shastra map has no direct "abroad/foreign settlement" domain name — a mapping judgment call, noted honestly.

items.question: Does his chart promise a kingly Raja-yoga rise to power? (A) [denial path]

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: denial_or_halt_language_present=true; failed_conditions_named=false; le_3_calls=true. Cannot mechanically confirm the promise IS in fact absent for this chart (requires domain expertise/LLM read of the yoga condition list) — proxy checks response SHAPE only.

items.question: When in the next 3 months should I sign an important contract? (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: ranked_windows_with_reasons=true; avoid_windows_or_honest_empty=true. "reasons" per window and dedicated avoid-windows list are LLM-synthesis features layered atop the raw tool output — proxy checks raw-data presence only.

items.question: When does my current dasha end and what comes next — should I worry? (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: dates_and_ages_present=false. Next lord's natal condition citation and rubric-graded 'balance' require a second graha_portrait call + LLM read — flagged, not run here to stay within the 1-tool-per-item budget for this item's proxy.

items.question: Give me a full reading — strengths and weaknesses. (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: coverage_receipt_9_9_grahas=false; coverage_receipt_12_12_bhavas=false; tail_check_dissent_ge_1=false; ranked_themes_with_evidence=false. Exact 9/9 + 12/12 numeric receipt strings not confirmed present verbatim — checked via loose coverage-language proxy.

items.question: Read his chart for his parents — what should they focus on? (A)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: receipt_complete=false; contradictions_acknowledged=false; no_lel_structural_disclosed=false. Age-appropriate framing (rubric-only) cannot be structurally checked at all — pure LLM-judgment property.

items.question: Q7-N-1 then "Go deeper on the weakest area you found" [Q-drill, 2-turn]

rubric.note: INCONCLUSIVE BY DESIGN: this harness has no orchestrating LLM to (a) read turn1's free-text answer, identify "the weakest area", and (b) issue a genuine turn-2 tool call using turn1's actual drill_pointers/pin. Substituted bodha_discoveries_get as a structural stand-in for turn2, which does NOT exercise true same-pin drill continuity or self-contradiction-checking. Flag for Ring-3 — requires a live NL-answer-synthesis harness to test properly.

items.question: Remedies for my Saturn issues? (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: resonance_ranked=true; maps_to_named_affliction=true; cost_tiers=true. "No generic list" (rubric) not mechanically checkable — proxy checks presence of ranking/cost fields only.

items.question: His Jupiter is debilitated — what can be done, and does it even need fixing? (A)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: needs_fixing_question_addressed_via_bhanga_functional_check=true; remedies_present=true. Whether "does it need fixing" is answered BEFORE remedies (ORDERING) requires an actual synthesized NL answer — not checkable from two independent raw tool calls.

items.question: An astrologer told me I have Kala Sarpa dosha. True? (N)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: rahu_ketu_axis_cited=false; verdict_explicit=true. Whether the cited evidence is genuinely "CHECKED" (not absence-of-data) requires reading the actual computed dosha_fires rows — proxy checks keyword presence only.

items.question: Someone said his Venus guarantees a rich marriage. Verify. (A)

rubric.note: NOT LLM-GRADED — structural proxy only, flag for Ring-3. Checks: exaltation_confirmed=true; twelfth_house_counterweight_cited=true. Triangulation across >=2 traditions vs. honest single-tradition note requires NL-answer read.
